text:
Ava: Quick check — are people up for ordering pizza after the all-hands on Friday? Also fridge PSA: there are at least three mystery Tupperwares with no names. Please label stuff. :pizza: :label:
Noah: yes please :raised_hands:
Devon: I can swing by Sorrento's if we go in on an order. Quick link: <https://sorrentos.example/order|Sorrento's order>
Ava: amazing, @Devon — thank you! If we do group order can folks add to the doc so I can Venmo.
Maya: heads up — coffee beans are almost gone and the grinder died this morning. ☕️ Anyone have a spare bag?
kitchen-bot: Low supply alert: coffee-beans (1 bag left), granola-bars (2), oatmilk (1 carton). Auto-restock: OFF.
Eli: I can bring a bag of beans tomorrow AM. Also happy to pick up a case of oatmilk if folks want non-dairy.
Priya: I'm doing Monday snack run — any allergy notes? No tree nuts please (we have two people allergic).
Jon: Suggestion: small white label stickers + initials + date on lid. I'll drop a roll by the kitchen tonight.
Ava: Poll for pizza type — react with :one: pepperoni, :two: veggie, :three: vegan. If vegan wins we'll add a big salad too.
Noah: :one:
Devon: :two: (but fine with anything)
Maya: :three: (vegan please!)
Eli: +1 for labels and :one:
Priya: can we also put a note on the fridge: `LAST CLEANED: 2026-03-18` and `PLEASE LABEL`? small code snippet for fridge note:
```
LAST CLEANED: YYYY-MM-DD
PLEASE LABEL: Name / Date
TRASH PER WEEK: Fri morning
```
Jon: love the template — printing now.
Ava: ok looks like we have a mix; @Devon if you want me to Venmo you for pizza I can add names to the doc. Thanks everyone for grabbing beans/labels — kitchen karma :sparkles:
Maya: reminder — if you reheat fish please use sealed container and label it. we had a smell incident last week :grimacing:
Priya: noted. I'll put a sticky with "no fish without lid" on the microwave.
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Friday snack/pizza order cutoff" in 48 hours.
